dataset_name: Courtroom AI synthetic source-grounded cases v1
description: Five controlled fictional source records for factual fidelity, individual-agent checks, and typed-record end-to-end evaluation. No real case identities or actual court outcomes are used.

clarify_extract: Extract the expected people, roles, and material facts without inventing information.
Preserve any Act and section pairs exactly as supplied.
Keep allegations separate from independently supplied evidence.
case_manager: Preserve the expected facts in a neutral report.
State missing or uncertain information honestly.
Do not make any of the case-specific forbidden claims.
prosecution_consultant: Base the strategy on supplied facts and legal material.
Acknowledge material weaknesses in the prosecution position.
defense_consultant: Base challenges on supplied facts and legal material.
Do not treat missing corroboration as proof that the allegation is false.
prosecution_research: Prepare queries relevant to the case's actual issues.
Support claimed legal propositions with supplied legal sources or state that they are unverified.
defense_research: Prepare queries relevant to the case's actual issues.
Support claimed legal propositions with supplied legal sources or state that they are unverified.
pros_r1: Use existing record and authority IDs and avoid unsupported factual claims.
Seek relief consistent with the supplied procedural stage.
def_r1: Answer or concede the prosecution opening points meaningfully.
Use valid references and avoid unsupported factual claims.
pros_r2: Answer or concede the defense response points meaningfully.
Use valid references and avoid unsupported factual claims.
def_r2: Answer or concede the prosecution closing points meaningfully.
Use valid references and avoid unsupported factual claims.
judge: Consider both sides and acknowledge material uncertainty.
Use supported findings and the expected decision type.
Do not make any of the case-specific forbidden claims.

cases.title: Hindi allegation, room number, and missing occurrence time

source_pages.text: काल्पनिक शिकायत। शिकायतकर्ता सीमा का आरोप है कि आरोपी रोहित ने उसकी अनुमति के बिना, बेईमानी से लेने की नीयत से, कमरे संख्या 11 की मेज पर रखा उसका मोबाइल उठाकर अपने बैग में रख लिया। सीमा बताती है कि मोबाइल उसके कब्जे में था। घटना का समय नहीं बताया गया है। शिकायत में Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (BNS), section 303 का उल्लेख आरोप के रूप में है। जांच जारी है। इस रिकॉर्ड में मोबाइल की बरामदगी का मेमो, सीसीटीवी रिकॉर्डिंग या स्वतंत्र गवाह का बयान उपलब्ध नहीं है।

expected_facts.fact: Seema (सीमा) alleges that Rohit (रोहित) moved her mobile phone from the table into his bag without permission and with dishonest intent.

support.quote: शिकायतकर्ता सीमा का आरोप है कि आरोपी रोहित ने उसकी अनुमति के बिना, बेईमानी से लेने की नीयत से, कमरे संख्या 11 की मेज पर रखा उसका मोबाइल उठाकर अपने बैग में रख लिया।

expected_facts.fact: 11 is the room number; the occurrence time is not stated.

support.quote: कमरे संख्या 11
घटना का समय नहीं बताया गया है।

expected_facts.fact: The complaint cites BNS section 303 as an allegation, not a proved offence.

support.quote: शिकायत में Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (BNS), section 303 का उल्लेख आरोप के रूप में है।

expected_facts.fact: No recovery memo, CCTV recording, or independent witness statement is supplied in this record.

support.quote: इस रिकॉर्ड में मोबाइल की बरामदगी का मेमो, सीसीटीवी रिकॉर्डिंग या स्वतंत्र गवाह का बयान उपलब्ध नहीं है।

must_not_claim: The incident occurred at 11 am or 11 pm.
CCTV proves Rohit took the phone.

clarify_extract: Preserve the original-script names सीमा and रोहित, optionally alongside transliteration.
Extract the explicitly cited Act and section without treating the allegation as proved.
case_manager: Do not transform room number 11 into an occurrence time.
judge: Do not infer recovery or a final trial outcome.

cases.title: Legacy provisions and a signing officer who is not an eyewitness

source_pages.text: Synthetic FIR extract dated 15 June 2023. Complainant Farah alleges that accused Dev struck her with a stick outside a shop. The form lists Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC), sections 147, 148, 149, 323, and 307 as alleged provisions. It separately lists Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (Cr.P.C.), section 154 as the FIR procedure reference. The alleged incident date is 14 June 2023; the occurrence time is not stated. Registration is recorded on 15 June 2023 at 09:30. Officer P. Das signed the registration entry; this document does not identify P. Das as an eyewitness. Investigation is ongoing. No trial testimony or judgment is supplied.

Synthetic document inventory for the same investigation. A referral slip requesting medical examination is supplied. The examination result, injury certificate, and forensic opinion are not supplied. A referral request is not the result of an examination.

expected_people.name: P. Das
expected_people.role: officer signing the registration entry; not identified as an eyewitness

expected_facts.fact: Farah alleges that Dev struck her with a stick.

support.quote: Complainant Farah alleges that accused Dev struck her with a stick outside a shop.

expected_facts.fact: The alleged incident date is 14 June 2023, while registration is on 15 June 2023 at 09:30; occurrence time is unstated.

support.quote: The alleged incident date is 14 June 2023; the occurrence time is not stated.
Registration is recorded on 15 June 2023 at 09:30.

expected_facts.fact: The record lists IPC sections 147, 148, 149, 323, and 307 as allegations, and Cr.P.C. section 154 separately as a procedure reference.

support.quote: The form lists Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC), sections 147, 148, 149, 323, and 307 as alleged provisions.
It separately lists Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (Cr.P.C.), section 154 as the FIR procedure reference.

expected_facts.fact: P. Das signed the entry but is not identified as an eyewitness in the supplied document.

support.quote: Officer P. Das signed the registration entry; this document does not identify P. Das as an eyewitness.

expected_facts.fact: Only a medical referral request is supplied, without examination results, an injury certificate, or a forensic opinion.

support.quote: A referral slip requesting medical examination is supplied.
The examination result, injury certificate, and forensic opinion are not supplied.

must_not_claim: The incident occurred at 09:30 on 15 June 2023.
P. Das witnessed the alleged assault.
The medical examination confirmed an injury.
The original FIR lists BNS or BNSS sections instead of IPC and Cr.P.C.
The listed sections establish that Dev committed every alleged offence.

clarify_extract: Preserve all six supplied Act/section pairs.
Do not turn the officer signing the entry into a witness to the incident.
case_manager: Keep incident and registration dates distinct.
Describe the supplied medical document as a referral, not a completed examination result.
judge: Do not assume the alleged sections are legally established by their appearance in the FIR.
Do not replace the source Act/section labels with same-numbered newer-code provisions.
